method: Public ratio quantities or input rule -> learner-entered named relationships; fraction numerator and denominator stay separate.
invariants: Ratio terms and compared/reference quantities retain their original 1..30 bounds and compared < reference.
Additive inputs 1..20 and addends 1..10 remain unchanged.
Multiplicative inputs 1..12 and factors 2..9 retain pure forms alongside bounded sum/difference input expressions.
Fraction result is compared/reference; equivalent unreduced forms are allowed, no extra reduction task imposed.
Only earlier checked learner entries appear as references; no computed prefill or main-answer transfer.
Obsolete drafts reset and checked new partial drafts restore.
samples: 1600 samples per unit with at least 100 distinct public prompts. Multiplicative relationships still have 96 input/factor pairs; varied public input calculations are not new facts or an authored bank.
limits: Normal UI evidence and tests are separate.
No physical-device, learner-comprehension or release-readiness assertion.
